turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Work let me go a few weeks ago. It's fine though, gives me more time to sort out the thing with my neighbors.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. It's never easy to lose a job, especially when you were doing well.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It's not as if I'm worried about finding a new one. I mean, I've been doing this for years. It's just... other things have taken up my time lately.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. Well, you can certainly take some time to focus on yourself and your own well-being.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (pauses, slightly guarded) Yeah, that's what I'm trying to do. Just figure some things out. (pauses again) Nothing's really changed, though. I still hear... the sounds. At night.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. (pauses) Do you want to talk about what those sounds are?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs slightly) No, it's nothing. Just the neighbors talking about me, I guess. Through the wall. They don't realize I'm listening. (trails off)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Okay, well, you know where to reach me if you need someone to talk to.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (nods, but with a hint of wariness) Yeah, I do. Thanks. (pauses, looks around the room) I really should get going.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Of course, no problem. I hope you feel better soon.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (gets up to leave, then turns back) You know, it's just... some days are easier than others. That's all.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Feel free to reach out anytime you need support.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (nods, turns to leave, and then stops at the door) Yeah, I will. Thanks. (exits the room)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text:
(remains seated, still alert) I'll be here if you need me.
